facts.fact: The Innovation Hub's media advisory of 2 June 2025 names ABSA Bank as senior funder with R71 million of the R83.1 million Enterprise Building 3 public-private partnership, with a sod-turning on 4 June 2025.

The advisory describes the R83.1 million Enterprise Building 3 expansion of The Innovation Hub as a public-private partnership with private partners Notre Damme Developments and Crowie Holdings, funded in part by ABSA's R71 million.
